userStories.title: Add mount-gated viewer-local dates to ticket components
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Add the shared date-only formatter and mount-gated viewer-local date helper, then migrate the three ticket-page components.

**Motivation** — The viewer sees the UTC time, then the local one.

**Approach** — Ruling (owner, 2026-11-12): times render in the viewer's zone, filled in after load; the server renders the `<time datetime>` element with no text.

`lib/format-date-time.ts` keeps `formatDateTime(iso, locale)` and gains:

```ts
/** "Nov 10, 2026": year numeric, month short, day numeric. An invalid date returns the input unchanged. */
export function formatDate(iso: string, locale: string | undefined): string
```

New `lib/local-dates.ts`. It is a composable but lives in `lib/` on purpose: an explicit import, not a Nuxt auto-import, so every existing `mountSfc` harness mounts its consumers without a new global.

The helper holds one `mounted` ref per call, set in `onMounted`. The server render never runs `onMounted`, and the client's hydration render runs before it, so both render `''`; Vue then re-renders with the local text. A component mounted later (client navigation) shows the text after one tick. The `-` for a missing value is the same on both sides, so it renders immediately.

Every site below switches to `useLocalDates(i18n)` and to one of the two formats: `dateTime` where it shows a time today, `date` where it shows only a date. A site that destructures `useI18n()` today keeps one `const i18n = useI18n()`, destructures what it still uses from it, passes `i18n` to `useLocalDates`, and drops locals that become unused (`locale`, `commentLocale`, `activeLocale`, `localTime`).

| Story | File | Today | After |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| US-001 | `components/CommentThread.vue` | `formatDateTime(comment.createdAt, commentLocale())` | `dates.dateTime(comment.createdAt)` |
| US-001 | `components/TicketHeader.vue` | local `formatDate` (`toLocaleDateString`, short) | `dates.date(...)` |
| US-001 | `components/TicketProperties.vue` | local `formatDate` (same) | `dates.date(...)` |

Read-only (verified, unchanged):
- `lib/format-date-time.ts` `formatDateTime(iso, locale)`: `toLocaleString(locale, { year: 'numeric', month: 'short', day: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })`, returns `iso` for an invalid date.
- `tests/helpers/mount-sfc.ts` mounts a real SFC through a custom renderer; `~/...` imports resolve to the real files under `apps/web` and share the test's one Vue runtime; Nuxt auto-imports come from `globals`. `app.mount` runs `onMounted` synchronously, and the re-render it triggers flushes on the next tick, so one `await nextTick()` shows the local text.
- `tests/components/comment-thread-time.spec.ts` is the CommentThread mount harness to reuse (i18n stub with a `locale` ref). `tests/layouts/default-fleet-nav.spec.ts` already loads `vue/server-renderer` under Jest.

Failure handling: `useLocalDates` gets an invalid date string -> `''` before mount; after mount the string unchanged (as `formatDateTime` does). `useLocalDates` gets null, undefined or '' -> Returns `-` before and after mount. i18n object without a string `locale.value` -> Formats with the runtime default locale.

Create tests/lib/local-dates.spec.ts with real h()-based SSR and custom-renderer mounts. Add formatDate cases to tests/lib/format-date-time.spec.ts; existing formatDateTime cases stay. In tests/components/comment-thread-time.spec.ts, the text now appears after one tick: the existing assertions move after await nextTick(), with an empty first-render assertion before it. Mount TicketHeader and TicketProperties to exercise the new export through real consumers. Preserve CommentThread's time element, datetime ISO and comment-time identifier.

**Scope** — In: lib/format-date-time.ts, new lib/local-dates.ts, CommentThread.vue, TicketHeader.vue, TicketProperties.vue and their behavioral tests. Out: the nine fleet/KB component sites in US-002; the seven page migrations, timeText removal and static guard in US-003; the GitHub reader optimization in US-004. No ticket workflow or permission changes. Relative times ("3 min ago") and a per-user time-zone setting are not added.

**Interface** —
```ts
import { onMounted, ref } from 'vue'
import { formatDate, formatDateTime } from '~/lib/format-date-time'

export interface LocalDates {
  /** '' until the calling component has mounted; then formatDateTime in the viewer's zone. null/undefined/'' -> '-'. */
  dateTime(iso: string | null | undefined): string
  /** Same gating; then formatDate. null/undefined/'' -> '-'. */
  date(iso: string | null | undefined): string
}

/** Call in a component's setup. `i18n` is the object useI18n() returned; its `locale.value` is read when it is a non-empty string, else the runtime default locale is used. */
export function useLocalDates(i18n: { locale?: { value?: unknown } } | undefined): LocalDates
```
acceptanceCriteria: [unit] formatDate('2026-11-10T14:07:45.657Z', 'en') returns date-only text including Nov and 2026 and excluding 14:07, 02:07 and T14.
[unit] formatDate('not-a-date', 'en') returns 'not-a-date'.

[unit] In tests/lib/local-dates.spec.ts, when an h()-based component calls useLocalDates({ locale: ref('en') }) in setup and renders h('time', { datetime: iso }, dates.dateTime(iso)) for iso '2026-11-10T14:07:45.657Z', renderToString from vue/server-renderer over createSSRApp(component) returns a time element with that datetime attribute and no text.

[unit] In tests/lib/local-dates.spec.ts, when the same dateTime component is mounted through a Vue.createRenderer recorder using the node and text recorders of tests/helpers/mount-sfc.ts, copied or exported, its time text is '' immediately after mount returns.
[unit] When that dateTime component has mounted and await nextTick() completes, its time text equals formatDateTime('2026-11-10T14:07:45.657Z', 'en').
[unit] When a variant renders dates.date('2026-11-10T14:07:45.657Z'), after mount and await nextTick() its text equals formatDate('2026-11-10T14:07:45.657Z', 'en').
[unit] useLocalDates dateTime/date return '-' for each of null, undefined and '' before mount.
[unit] useLocalDates dateTime/date return '-' for each of null, undefined and '' after mount.
[unit] useLocalDates dateTime/date return '' for 'not-a-date' before mount.
[unit] useLocalDates dateTime/date return 'not-a-date' for 'not-a-date' after mount.

[unit] When useLocalDates receives { locale: { value: 42 } } or undefined as its i18n argument, after mount dateTime('2026-11-10T14:07:45.657Z') returns formatDateTime('2026-11-10T14:07:45.657Z', undefined).

[unit] When useLocalDates receives { locale: {} } or { locale: { value: '' } }, after mount dateTime('2026-11-10T14:07:45.657Z') returns formatDateTime('2026-11-10T14:07:45.657Z', undefined), selecting the runtime default locale.

[unit] When CommentThread is mounted using the comment-thread-time harness with locale ref 'en' and a comment createdAt '2026-11-10T14:07:45.657Z', immediately after mountSfc returns its comment-time node is a time element with datetime '2026-11-10T14:07:45.657Z', preserving the existing semantic time markup.
[unit] When that CommentThread mountSfc call returns, the comment-time text is ''.
[unit] When that CommentThread mount uses locale ref 'en', after await nextTick() comment-time text equals formatDateTime('2026-11-10T14:07:45.657Z', 'en').
[unit] When that CommentThread mount uses locale ref 'zh', after await nextTick() comment-time text equals formatDateTime('2026-11-10T14:07:45.657Z', 'zh').

[unit] When TicketHeader is mounted with ticket.createdAt '2026-11-10T14:07:45.657Z' and an i18n locale ref 'en', it does not render formatDate('2026-11-10T14:07:45.657Z', 'en') immediately after mount.
[unit] When that TicketHeader mount completes await nextTick(), it renders formatDate('2026-11-10T14:07:45.657Z', 'en').

[unit] When TicketProperties is mounted with ticket.createdAt '2026-11-10T14:07:45.657Z' and an i18n locale ref 'en', it does not render formatDate('2026-11-10T14:07:45.657Z', 'en') immediately after mount.
[unit] When that TicketProperties mount completes await nextTick(), it renders formatDate('2026-11-10T14:07:45.657Z', 'en').

routing.reasoning: A small onMounted/ref helper and additive formatter use standard Vue patterns in three ticket consumers; existing SSR and custom-renderer harnesses support direct failing tests without an architectural change.

userStories.title: Migrate fleet and KB component dates to the shared helper
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Use mount-gated viewer-local dates in the nine fleet and KB component sites while preserving existing missing/invalid activity semantics.

**Motivation** — Several use the bare `toLocaleString()` (numeric date with seconds) while others use the short form, so the app shows two date styles.

**Approach** — The helper holds one `mounted` ref per call, set in `onMounted`. The server render never runs `onMounted`, and the client's hydration render runs before it, so both render `''`; Vue then re-renders with the local text. A component mounted later (client navigation) shows the text after one tick. The `-` for a missing value is the same on both sides, so it renders immediately.

Every site below switches to `useLocalDates(i18n)` and to one of the two formats: `dateTime` where it shows a time today, `date` where it shows only a date. A site that destructures `useI18n()` today keeps one `const i18n = useI18n()`, destructures what it still uses from it, passes `i18n` to `useLocalDates`, and drops locals that become unused (`locale`, `commentLocale`, `activeLocale`, `localTime`).

| Story | File | Today | After |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| US-002 | `components/KbResultCard.vue` | `new Date(createdAt).toLocaleDateString(locale)` | `dates.date(createdAt)` |
| US-002 | `components/fleet/BudgetTable.vue` | `new Date(policy.pausedAt).toLocaleString()` | `dates.dateTime(policy.pausedAt)` |
| US-002 | `components/fleet/FleetJobTimeline.vue` | `new Date(event.createdAt).toLocaleString()` in the `rows` computed | `dates.dateTime(event.createdAt)` |
| US-002 | `components/fleet/EnrollmentTokenDialog.vue` | `new Date(created.expiresAt).toLocaleString()` | `dates.dateTime(created.expiresAt)` |
| US-002 | `components/fleet/threads/ThreadPreApprovalCard.vue` | `new Date(thread.preApproval.at).toLocaleString()` | `dates.dateTime(thread.preApproval.at)` |
| US-002 | `components/fleet/threads/ThreadListTable.vue` | `activityText`: `timeText(value)` behind a finite-date guard, else `-` | `activityText` moves into setup after `useLocalDates`, keeps its finite-date guard and calls `dates.dateTime(value)` only for a valid date, else `-` |
| US-002 | `components/fleet/analytics/JobTable.vue` | `timeText(row.finishedAt)` | `dates.dateTime(row.finishedAt)` |
| US-002 | `components/fleet/analytics/IngestTable.vue` | `timeText(row.updatedAt)` | `dates.dateTime(row.updatedAt)` |
| US-002 | `components/fleet/analytics/StoryTable.vue` | `timeText(row.completedAt)` | `dates.dateTime(row.completedAt)` |

New `lib/local-dates.ts`. It is a composable but lives in `lib/` on purpose: an explicit import, not a Nuxt auto-import, so every existing `mountSfc` harness mounts its consumers without a new global.

Use the module produced by US-001; do not recreate it. `timeText` stays exported until US-003 (the flows page still uses it). The helper's general invalid input contract is unchanged, but ThreadListTable must continue returning '-' for an invalid or absent lastActivityAt through its finite-date guard. Keep computed timeline formatting reactive to mounted state and locale.

Read-only (verified, unchanged): `tests/helpers/mount-sfc.ts` mounts a real SFC through a custom renderer; `~/...` imports resolve to the real files under `apps/web` and share the test's one Vue runtime; Nuxt auto-imports come from `globals`. `app.mount` runs `onMounted` synchronously, and the re-render it triggers flushes on the next tick, so one `await nextTick()` shows the local text.

Update tests/components/KbResultCard.spec.ts: the source assertion `toLocaleDateString(\s*locale` (line 122) becomes an assertion that the card imports `useLocalDates` from the local-dates lib module. Update tests/components/thread-preapproval-card.spec.ts: it expects `new Date(at).toLocaleString()`; it now expects `formatDateTime(at, <the stub's locale or undefined>)` after `await nextTick()`. Update tests/components/fleet-budget-table.spec.ts: the paused-row test (line 131) asserts synchronously after mount; it becomes async and awaits `nextTick()` before the assertion. Extend existing component harnesses for ThreadListTable, JobTable and FleetJobTimeline. The shared enI18n test helper has no locale ref, so use undefined in expected formatDateTime unless the mount explicitly supplies a locale.

**Scope** — In: the nine component migrations and their existing tests. Out: creating or changing the US-001 date-helper contract or ticket migration; all US-003 page migrations, timeText removal and the static guard; US-004 GitHub optimization. Permission and token behavior in pre-approval/enrollment components stays unchanged.

**Interface** — consumed from US-001:
```ts
export interface LocalDates {
  /** '' until the calling component has mounted; then formatDateTime in the viewer's zone. null/undefined/'' -> '-'. */
  dateTime(iso: string | null | undefined): string
  /** Same gating; then formatDate. null/undefined/'' -> '-'. */
  date(iso: string | null | undefined): string
}

/** Call in a component's setup. `i18n` is the object useI18n() returned; its `locale.value` is read when it is a non-empty string, else the runtime default locale is used. */
export function useLocalDates(i18n: { locale?: { value?: unknown } } | undefined): LocalDates
```
acceptanceCriteria: [unit] When ThreadPreApprovalCard is mounted with preApproval.at '2026-01-02T03:04:05.000Z', after await nextTick() its text contains formatDateTime('2026-01-02T03:04:05.000Z', the stub locale or undefined).
[unit] When ThreadListTable is mounted with a thread whose lastActivityAt is 'not-a-date', its last-activity cell renders '-', preserving the existing finite-date guard.
[unit] When ThreadListTable is mounted with a thread whose lastActivityAt is null, its last-activity cell renders '-'.

[unit] When ThreadListTable is mounted with lastActivityAt '2026-11-10T14:07:45.657Z', after await nextTick() that last-activity cell renders formatDateTime('2026-11-10T14:07:45.657Z', the stub locale or undefined).

[unit] When BudgetTable is mounted with a paused policy whose pausedAt is '2026-10-02T03:04:05.000Z', after await nextTick() that row's text contains formatDateTime('2026-10-02T03:04:05.000Z', the stub locale or undefined).

[unit] When JobTable is mounted with a row whose finishedAt is '2026-11-10T14:07:45.657Z', after await nextTick() that row renders formatDateTime('2026-11-10T14:07:45.657Z', the stub locale or undefined).
[unit] When JobTable is mounted with a row whose finishedAt is null, that row renders '-' for its finish time.

[unit] When FleetJobTimeline is mounted with one event whose createdAt is '2026-11-10T14:07:45.657Z', after await nextTick() that row's text contains formatDateTime('2026-11-10T14:07:45.657Z', the stub locale or undefined).

routing.reasoning: The nine component edits repeat the already-tested helper integration; existing mount harnesses cover the computed timeline and finite-date guard without new abstractions or changes to token/permission logic.

userStories.title: Migrate page dates and prevent runtime-zone formatting regressions
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Migrate the seven remaining page sites, remove timeText after its last consumer, and enforce the shared mount-gated formatting boundary.

**Motivation** — They are clean today only because their data loads on the client; any of them that moves to a server fetch would mismatch the same way.

**Approach** — The helper holds one `mounted` ref per call, set in `onMounted`. The server render never runs `onMounted`, and the client's hydration render runs before it, so both render `''`; Vue then re-renders with the local text. A component mounted later (client navigation) shows the text after one tick. The `-` for a missing value is the same on both sides, so it renders immediately.

Every site below switches to `useLocalDates(i18n)` and to one of the two formats: `dateTime` where it shows a time today, `date` where it shows only a date. A site that destructures `useI18n()` today keeps one `const i18n = useI18n()`, destructures what it still uses from it, passes `i18n` to `useLocalDates`, and drops locals that become unused (`locale`, `commentLocale`, `activeLocale`, `localTime`).

| Story | File | Today | After |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| US-003 | `pages/notifications.vue` | `new Date(item.createdAt).toLocaleString()` inside `<time :datetime>` | `dates.dateTime(item.createdAt)` |
| US-003 | `pages/admin/audit.vue` | `localTime(iso)` (`toLocaleString(activeLocale)`) | `dates.dateTime(iso)` |
| US-003 | `pages/[project]/timeline.vue` | local `formatDate` (`toLocaleString`, short with time) | keeps a local `formatDate(dateStr)` that returns `dates.dateTime(dateStr)`, so the template and `tests/pages/timeline.spec.ts` (which compiles the template with its own `formatDate`) are unchanged |
| US-003 | `pages/[project]/kb.vue` | local `formatDate` (`toLocaleDateString(locale.value)`) | `dates.date(...)` |
| US-003 | `pages/[project]/fleet/index.vue` | `new Date(job.queuedAt).toLocaleString()` | `dates.dateTime(job.queuedAt)` |
| US-003 | `pages/[project]/fleet/jobs/[id]/index.vue` | `formatTime` (`toLocaleString()`, `-` for null; Queued, Started, Finished, Last heartbeat, cancel-requested text) | `dates.dateTime(iso)` |
| US-003 | `pages/[project]/flows/[id].vue` | `timeText(...)` for Created and Approved | `dates.dateTime(...)` |

US-003 then removes `timeText` from `lib/fleet-analytics-format.ts` (its last consumer is gone). Removal gate: `bun run type-check` in `apps/web` fails if any consumer still imports it.

Static gate (not an AC): US-003 adds `tests/lib/no-runtime-zone-dates.spec.ts`, which scans every `.vue` and `.ts` file under `apps/web/components`, `pages`, `layouts`, `composables` and `lib` (tests excluded) and fails, naming each file, on a match for `/\.toLocale(Date|Time)?String\(/` outside `lib/format-date-time.ts`, or on an import whose path ends in `/format-date-time` in any file other than `lib/local-dates.ts`. It keeps new sites from returning to the runtime zone.

`lib/fleet-schedules.ts` is unchanged: it formats with an explicit `timeZone`, the same on both sides.

Consume the existing explicitly imported helper from US-001; no new Nuxt globals. The helper returns invalid strings unchanged after mount and '-' immediately for missing values, using runtime default locale if i18n.locale.value is not a non-empty string. Preserve notifications' time/datetime markup, the timeline template/wrapper seam and all existing page fetching, permissions and conditional rows.

Modify tests/lib/fleet-analytics-format.spec.ts to remove the timeText cases; the other cases stay. Update tests/pages/fleet-flow-detail.spec.ts and tests/pages/flow-detail-readable.spec.ts: each expects `new Date(...).toLocaleString()`; it now expects `formatDateTime(..., <the stub's locale or undefined>)` after `await nextTick()`. Extend existing notifications, job-detail, audit and flow page mounts to exercise the real helper. Client-loaded records may require existing promise-settle helpers as well as nextTick. The static guard and type-check are validation requirements, not additional acceptance criteria.

**Scope** — In: the seven page migrations, removing timeText and its tests/imports, and the static guard. Out: redoing the US-001 ticket/helper implementation or US-002 component migrations; the US-004 GitHub reader changes. `lib/fleet-schedules.ts` (explicit time zone) and its default-zone helper for the schedule form are unchanged. `lib/fleet-log-view.ts` `logTime` (log line times from `getHours()`) is unchanged: job logs load on the client only.

**Interface** — consumed from US-001:
```ts
export interface LocalDates {
  /** '' until the calling component has mounted; then formatDateTime in the viewer's zone. null/undefined/'' -> '-'. */
  dateTime(iso: string | null | undefined): string
  /** Same gating; then formatDate. null/undefined/'' -> '-'. */
  date(iso: string | null | undefined): string
}

/** Call in a component's setup. `i18n` is the object useI18n() returned; its `locale.value` is read when it is a non-empty string, else the runtime default locale is used. */
export function useLocalDates(i18n: { locale?: { value?: unknown } } | undefined): LocalDates
```
acceptanceCriteria: [unit] When pages/notifications.vue is mounted with one record whose createdAt is '2026-11-10T14:07:45.657Z', after await nextTick() that row's time element retains datetime '2026-11-10T14:07:45.657Z'.
[unit] When that notifications page record is rendered after await nextTick(), its time text equals formatDateTime('2026-11-10T14:07:45.657Z', the stub locale or undefined).

[unit] When pages/[project]/fleet/jobs/[id]/index.vue is mounted with a RUNNING job whose lastHeartbeatAt is null and queuedAt is '2026-11-10T14:07:45.657Z', Last heartbeat reads '-' immediately after mount.
[unit] When that RUNNING job mount completes await nextTick(), Queued reads formatDateTime('2026-11-10T14:07:45.657Z', the stub locale or undefined).

[unit] When pages/admin/audit.vue is mounted with an entry whose createdAt is '2026-11-10T14:07:45.657Z', after await nextTick() that row renders formatDateTime('2026-11-10T14:07:45.657Z', the stub locale or undefined).

[unit] When pages/[project]/flows/[id].vue is mounted with a flow whose createdAt is '2026-01-02T03:04:05.000Z', after await nextTick() Created renders formatDateTime('2026-01-02T03:04:05.000Z', the stub locale or undefined).

routing.reasoning: Seven page edits reuse the established helper and existing page harnesses; removing timeText and adding a filesystem guard are straightforward, with the timeline wrapper retained and access policy untouched.

userStories.title: List GitHub nax files with one direct subtree request
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Add GitHubAppClient.getSubtree and replace the GitHub reader's two tree requests with a direct commit:.nax subtree request.

**Motivation** — `GithubFleetRepoFilesReader.list` runs mint token -> branch head -> root tree -> `.nax` tree, one after another.

**Approach** — R2-21: fewer GitHub calls, D468 (fresh token per request, no caching) unchanged.

`GitHubAppClient` gains the interface below. It requests `GET /repos/{owner}/{name}/git/trees/{encodeURIComponent(commitSha + ':' + dirPath)}` (plus `?recursive=1` when `recursive`) and parses the body exactly as `getTree` does (share the parser).

`GithubFleetRepoFilesReader.list` becomes: token -> `getBranchHead` -> `getSubtree(token, owner, name, baseSha, '.nax', true)`. null -> `{ baseSha, defaultBranch, files: [] }`; truncated -> `ForgeErrorException`; otherwise the entries, prefixed `.nax/`, through `toNaxEntries`. Three sequential GitHub requests instead of four; the token is still minted per request (D468). `read` is unchanged.

Read-only (verified, unchanged):
- `apps/api/src/fleet/git-broker/github-app-client.ts` `getTree(token, owner, name, treeish, recursive)` URL-encodes `treeish`, maps any non-200 and a body without a `tree` array to `RepoCheckException('provider_error')`; `getBranchHead` maps 404 to `repo_not_found`. `getTree` is also used by `src/fleet/knowledge/knowledge-repo-indexer.ts` and stays unchanged.
- `apps/api/test/helpers/fake-forge.ts` routes on the raw request path (a literal `%3A` path matches) and records the query string separately.
- `apps/api/src/fleet/repo-config/fleet-repo-files.reader.ts` `toNaxEntries` filters and sorts entries; `forgeCall` maps `RepoCheckException` to 409/502.
- `apps/api/test/integration/fleet/fleet-repo-config-api.integration.spec.ts` drives the real `GithubFleetRepoFilesReader` against the fake forge: it routes `git/trees/${HEAD}` and `git/trees/naxTree`, and its VIEWER test expects 2 listed files. The other nax-files integration specs spy on `reader.list` and are unaffected.

Failure handling:
| Case | Behaviour |
|:--|:--|
| `.nax` missing at the head commit (404) | `list` returns no files, as today. The branch head was just read with the same token, so a 404 on the subtree is taken to mean "no `.nax`", not a lost repo. |
| `.nax` is a file (422) | `list` returns no files, as today (the old code ignored a non-tree `.nax`). |
| Tree request fails otherwise, or returns a body without `tree` | 502 (`ForgeErrorException`), as today. |
| `.nax` tree truncated | 502, as today. |

Share only the tree parser: keep getTree's external request/status behavior unchanged, including non-200 errors. The parser still drops entries other than blob/tree and entries without string path/sha, maps missing numeric size to null, and treats only truncated === true as truncated. getSubtree's 404/422-to-null semantics must not leak to getTree/getBranchHead. Use the existing FleetHttpClient and existing error/allowlist helpers. Do not log or persist minted tokens, change installation-token scope, or use the job/epoch broker cache.

Extend src/fleet/git-broker/github-app-client.spec.ts in the `.nax reads (fleet S3 §4.1)` describe with the getSubtree cases.
